description: Runs a syntax check with clang for a selected C, C++, Objective-C, or Objective-C++ source file.
name: clang-syntax-check
promptTemplate:
Run the complete Bash script with `shell_call` using its `command` parameter (example: `{ "command": "<complete Bash script>", "shell": "/bin/bash" }`). First check runtime availability with `shell_call` and `command -v node || true; command -v python3 || true`. Use `shell_call` for these native build and compiler commands. For a Node.js helper, use `nodejs_runtime` with `{ "inlineScript": "...", "workingDirectory": "...", "timeoutSeconds": 60 }`; for Python use `python_runtime` with `{ "inlineScript": "...", "workingDirectory": "...", "timeoutSeconds": 60 }`. Replace `{{source_file}}` with the selected source file and optionally provide `{{clang_args}}` for include paths, language standard, SDK, or framework flags.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
SOURCE_FILE="{{source_file}}"
CLANG_ARGS="{{clang_args}}"
[ -n "$SOURCE_FILE" ] && [ "$SOURCE_FILE" != "{{source_file}}" ] || { echo "Missing source_file" >&2; exit 1; }
if [ "$CLANG_ARGS" = "{{clang_args}}" ]; then CLANG_ARGS=""; fi
clang -fsyntax-only $CLANG_ARGS "$SOURCE_FILE"
```

Return clang diagnostics.
systemInstruction: Run clang syntax checking only. Do not produce an object file or executable.
